title: Why are cells small?
summary: A scientific essay exploring the biological constraints that limit cell size, including the surface-area-to-volume ratio, diffusion limits, and the balance between DNA and protein production, explaining why cells must remain small to function efficiently.
problem_solved: Explains the fundamental biological question of what physical and biochemical factors constrain cell size.
why_valuable: Provides clear, accessible explanations of cell biology principles that are often poorly understood, helping readers grasp why this fundamental constraint exists across all living organisms.
